ad.title: One-off ad
ad.description: One strong ad, scripted, filmed and edited. Includes a planning call and one shoot of up to 3 hours.

monthly.title: Monthly Content System
monthly.description: One filming day of up to 6 hours, 10–12 videos and 15–20 stills. A month of content shaped around your audience.
monthly.note: Monthly planning, hooks and captions, two combined revision rounds and a review of what worked.

founder.title: Founder Content Partner
founder.description: Two filming sessions and 16–20 videos, with content pillars, recurring series and script frameworks.
founder.note: Versions for LinkedIn, TikTok and Instagram, a monthly review and async communication between sessions.
